review.mathCheck: \(4000(2/5)^n=2^{5+n}5^{3-n}\) is integral exactly when both exponents are nonnegative. Thus \(-5\le n\le3\), including both endpoints, gives 9 integers, choice E. Outside this interval an uncancelled denominator remains.
